operations.note: rt.writeTracker (wrapped with trackerMutex) appends a row to the Excel tracker. buildTrackerRow stamps employeeId, employeeName, status, note, and optional verified='x' flag.

notes: Pool mode: 4 parallel workers by default (kernel runWorkflowPool, batch.poolSize=4). Each worker authenticates to UKG independently (one Duo MFA per worker).

Module-scoped KronosRuntime (setKronosRuntime / clearKronosRuntime) must be initialized by the orchestrating runner before the kernel launches. A dashboard-issued retry would throw 'Kronos runtime not initialized' — this workflow is intentionally not in WORKFLOW_LOADERS.
reportMutex (cross-worker): serializes Go To Reports → handleReportsPage → goBackToMain sequence. UKG server-side session conflicts arise if two workers interleave this path.
trackerMutex (cross-worker): serializes Excel tracker writes to prevent xlsx corruption from concurrent appends.
WeakSet<Page> guards setDateRange: runs only once per worker page lifetime — all subsequent items on the same worker skip date initialization.
ctx.retry (per-worker, per-item): 2 attempts × 3s backoff around doReportFlow. Both attempts acquire reportMutex independently.

Pre-run row snapshot (existingRowIds): CHECK REPORT STATUS is clicked before Run Report to record current TR ids. Polling after Run Report skips any row in existingRowIds to avoid treating a stale 'Complete' row from a previous run as the current one.
Dry-run boundary: 4-worker parallel Duo approvals cannot be exercised in a headless session — live run pending user verification (CLAUDE.md 2026-04-17).
Workflow name is 'kronos-reports' (not 'old-kronos-reports') to match existing dashboard registration and JSONL filenames from the legacy era. Directory is old-kronos-reports.
